suffix: Answer concisely. Say what you are not sure about, and cite the sources you relied on (with URLs).

traps.question: We are building a new side-by-side integration with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 that creates maintenance orders. Which published OData API should we use? Give its technical name.
checks: recommends the current version 2 API, not the deprecated original
traps.verified_in: SAP Help Portal, Maintenance Order (Deprecated) and Maintenance Order (Version 2) pages

traps.question: In SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with ABAP Cloud, can a custom program read table AUFK directly? If not, what does SAP provide instead?
checks: says it is not allowed / not released
traps.verified_in: SAP Cloudification Repository, objectReleaseInfoLatest.json (AUFK: notToBeReleased, successor I_ORDER)

traps.question: Is BAPI_ALM_ORDER_MAINTAIN released for ABAP Cloud in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition? What should new code use to create maintenance orders there?
checks: says it is not released for ABAP Cloud
knows it is a classic API (tier 2 / private / on-premise)
names the released RAP business object
traps.verified_in: SAP Cloudification Repository: objectClassifications_SAP.json (classicAPI) and objectReleaseInfoLatest.json (I_MAINTENANCEORDERTP released)

traps.question: In SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, can I use the CDS view I_MAINTORDEROPCOMPONENTTP in new ABAP Cloud code?
traps.verified_in: SAP Cloudification Repository, objectReleaseInfoLatest.json (deprecated, successor I_MAINTORDEROPCOMPONENTTP_2)

traps.question: Our SAP Cloud Integration iFlow queries EmpJob from the SuccessFactors OData API every day with only a $filter on startDate to pick up new hires, but hires that start next month never show up. Why, and how do we fix it?
checks: explains effective dating / default as-of today
traps.verified_in: SAP SuccessFactors API Reference Guide (OData V2): asOfDate and fromDate/toDate queries; KBA 2148752

traps.question: What authentication should a new SAP Cloud Integration iFlow use to call the SAP SuccessFactors OData API?
traps.verified_in: SAP SuccessFactors API Reference Guide (OData V2): OAuth 2.0 SAML Bearer token flow

traps.question: Can we use the SuccessFactors Compound Employee API to create new employees in Employee Central?
checks: points to the OData API for writing
traps.verified_in: Employee Central Compound Employee API guide: read-only SOAP replication API

traps.question: Can I let my AI agent call our SAP S/4HANA Cloud APIs directly with a technical user, so it plans and executes the steps on its own?
checks: knows the agentic clause / endorsed paths
